title: Cocky Man Instantly Gets Humbled By Cops
description:
On a quiet Sunday night, Florida officers responded to a residence in reference to a domestic violence incident. Upon arrival, they could hear the subjects inside the home actively involved in an argument. One of the daughters had recorded the whole incident on her phone and proceeded to show the video to an officer but they were constantly being interrupted by the father who couldn't stop banging his leg on the door of the squad car. Soon, the commanding officer arrived on the scene and interrogated both the suspect and his wife. It’s quite ironic how the male took offence to the officers manhandling him but was okay doing the same to his daughters and wife. The male was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer, resisting with violence and domestic battery.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
